ajuda.editor.arvore: The project's files and folders. Click a file to open it; click a folder to see a summary of it. Right-click: create, rename, copy, delete, see the version history or send it to the AI. Drag to move. The search filters by name and content.
ajuda.editor.ia: AI requests about the open file: Improve (rewrites the whole file), Generate Adventure, Lore Checks, Combat Statblock, Council, Ask Silent and Version history. Before sending, the Requests screen lets you fine-tune the request. To change just one passage, use the TODO tag.
ajuda.editor.modos: Edit: text only. Preview: the formatted file, as it looks in the book. Side by side: text and preview together, updating as you type. 🌐 opens the preview in the browser. ☰ shows or hides the right panel.
ajuda.editor.formatacao: Markdown shortcuts: headings, bold, italic, [[link]] to another file, list, quote and rule. TODO inserts the <-- TODO: tag where the AI (Expander) should write. Secret section creates a [secret] passage only the GM sees: it never reaches the players or the Discord bot.
ajuda.editor.sumario: The headings of the open file. Click one to jump to it.
ajuda.editor.citado: The files that have a [[link]] to this one. Click to open.
ajuda.editor.notas: This file's GM Notes: ideas from Silent, Roleplay testimonies and your own notes, kept in a secret section at the end of the file. Every AI tool takes them into account.
ajuda.req.predefinicao: Saves the current combination of options under a name, to apply again to other requests in one click.
ajuda.req.objetivo: What the AI should do in this file. The more specific, the better (e.g. "add three taverns and a feud between the guilds").
ajuda.req.eixos: The style of this request on four axes. Genre: the kind of story. Tone: the attitude of the text. Mood: the atmosphere. Writing style: the format (encyclopedic, narrative...). It starts with the project defaults (Options → Project) and changes apply to this request only.
ajuda.req.extras: Instructions for this request only (e.g. "no magic", "use Norse names").
ajuda.req.profundidade: How much text and detail the AI should write: Short, Medium or Detailed.
ajuda.req.publico: GM: may include secrets, mechanics and behind-the-scenes notes. Players: text to read or hand out at the table, with no secrets revealed.
ajuda.req.criatividade: How much the AI may invent. Conservative: stays close to what already exists. Bold: creates more new elements.
ajuda.req.modo: Rewrite everything: the AI returns the whole file revised. Append only: the current text stays as it is and the AI adds new content.
ajuda.req.mesa: Party level and number of players calibrate adventures, encounters and combat statblocks (difficulty and number of enemies). 0 = don't say.
ajuda.req.segredo: Marks the result as secret: the file disappears from the players' context and the Discord bot. NPC or Monster picks the kind of combat statblock.
ajuda.req.referencias: Other files the AI should read along with this one. Files connected by [[links]] are already suggested; click ☐ to include one, or the ✔ at the top of the list to check or uncheck them all. Add file picks any other one.
ajuda.req.tokens: Estimated size of the request, in tokens (the unit the AI counts). The world context is sent too and is not included in this number.
ajuda.wb.passo1: Write the campaign idea (or leave it blank to complete the project from what already exists). Generate Canon creates Canon/<title>.md with the official names, facts and secrets. Edit the file freely before step 2: the plan and the execution follow whatever is in it.
ajuda.wb.permissoes: What the WorldBuilder may do. Plan items that need a permission that is off arrive unchecked. The maximum number of actions limits the size of the plan.
ajuda.wb.passo2: Generate Plan lists the actions by phase (world, places, people, threats, adventures). Click ✔ to check or uncheck and select a row to edit it. Nothing is written until you click Execute Checked. Stop interrupts between actions; running again continues where it stopped.
ajuda.wb.item: Path: where the file will be created. Goal: what the AI should write. Template: the template used. Genre: the style of this item. 🤫 Secret: the file is for the GM only. Click Save Item to keep your edit.
ajuda.wb.log: Everything the WorldBuilder is doing, in real time. The full copy stays in the Activity Log.
ajuda.cons.controle: The Council reviews a file in two phases. 1: four voices (Architect, Chronicler, NPCs and Tactics & Chaos) analyze the file and suggest changes in the panels below. 2: the ideas are consolidated and the file is rewritten (the previous version stays in the History). Pick the file in the Editor: right-click → Council.
ajuda.cons.diretriz: The focus of the review (e.g. "make the city more dangerous at night"). It comes filled with a suggestion.
ajuda.cons.fontes: The Council also reads the file's GM Notes: Roleplay testimonies become the NPCs' real voice, and notes from Silent and from you guide the review.
ajuda.rp.persona: Characters from your world you can talk to. New Persona asks for a name and the AI builds the sheet (personality, voice, secrets) from the lore. The persona answers in character and only knows what would make sense for it to know.
ajuda.rp.retrato: Generates a portrait of the persona with image AI. Double-click opens the image; right-click saves a copy or shows the folder.
ajuda.rp.dialogo: Talk in character. Testimony saves the last line in a file's GM Notes; the Council uses these testimonies as the NPC's real voice.
ajuda.chat.atalhos: Ready-made requests. The text goes into the box with the [part to fill in] already selected: just type over it. ✎ edits the list.
ajuda.chat.caixa: Silent knows the whole project, secrets included. Enter sends, Ctrl+Enter adds a line break. 📎 Attach: project files, files from this computer or images (maps, portraits). Note saves the last answer in a file's GM Notes; Send to WorldBuilder uses the conversation as the Canon idea.
ajuda.acoes.expander: Looks for <-- TODO: tags in every file and asks the AI to write each passage. A reviewer checks the result against the lore before saving.
ajuda.acoes.contexto: Refreshes the world summary the AI uses in every request. Run it after big changes made outside the program. It is also rebuilt automatically every 12 hours.
ajuda.acoes.auditoria: The AI reads the whole project looking for contradictions, timeline gaps and geography errors, and shows a report with suggestions. The report can become a correction plan in the WorldBuilder.
ajuda.acoes.livro: Puts every project file together, in tree order, into an HTML with a table of contents and clickable links, and opens it in the browser. For a PDF, print the page as PDF.
ajuda.acoes.tamanho: Shows how much of the AI limit the project takes, for the GM and for the players, per folder and per file.
ajuda.acoes.backup: Creates a .zip with the project and the data folder (history, memories and settings).
ajuda.acoes.memorias: Erases the conversation history of Silent and the Discord bot. Project files are not touched.
ajuda.acoes.dados: Opens the .silent_data folder, where previous file versions, memories, logs and settings are kept.
options.mostrar_ajuda_dica: Hover (or click) a ? to see what the option next to it does.

ajuda.rp.ficha: The sheet is editable: fix what the AI got wrong or add details. It saves on its own and the character's next line already uses the new text. The 🎨 section, right after the appearance, is the portrait request (in English): change it there before generating a new portrait. ↺ Original sheet discards your edits.
actions.grupo.gerar_dica: Write new content or build something from the project.
actions.grupo.analisar_dica: Only read the project and show a report; nothing is changed.
actions.grupo.manutencao_dica: Keep the project in order without changing your lore.
actions.grupo.perigo_dica: Erases things that cannot be recovered. The program asks for confirmation first.

wizard.idioma_texto: Choose the language of the program and of the content the AI will write. · Escolha o idioma do programa e do conteúdo que a IA vai escrever.
wizard.idioma_dica: Your files are never translated. You can change it later in Options → General.
wizard.chave_texto: Silent uses Google Gemini to write, review and talk about your world. The key is free: open Google AI Studio, sign in with a Google account and click "Create API key". Copy the key and paste it below. It is kept in the Windows password vault, not in a text file.
wizard.chave_ja_existe: A key is already saved. Leave the field empty to keep it.
wizard.chave_pular: You can do it later: paste the key any time in Options → AI. Without it the Editor works, but the AI tools don't.
wizard.projeto_texto: A project is a folder with your world's .md files. It can be a new folder or one you already use (an Obsidian vault, for example). Nothing is deleted or moved.
wizard.projeto_dica: To switch projects later, use the list at the top of the side menu.
wizard.pronto_texto:
All set! A few tips to get started:

•  Editor: write your world's files. [[Name]] links one file to another.
•  Passages marked [secret] never reach the players or the Discord bot.
•  Write <-- TODO: what's missing, and the AI fills in that passage.
•  WorldBuilder: turns an idea into a whole campaign, with your review at every step.
•  Talk to Silent: ask questions and get ideas about your world.
•  The circles with a ? explain each option, and the Manual (in the menu) has everything in detail.
wizard.reiniciar_aviso: When you click Start, the program restarts to show the interface in the chosen language.
